generations.prompt: A Caucasian man in his late 50s with short graying hair and neat goatee sits motionless at his desk in a sterile corporate office, staring down at a red stapler with a resigned, deadpan expression. The camera holds a medium shot from slightly above, capturing his defeated posture against beige cubicle partitions and thick square support pillars. Cool fluorescent lights from the grid-patterned drop ceiling cast harsh, even illumination across the monochromatic greige and off-white environment. The accountant's eyes remain fixed on the stapler, his face conveying the quiet desperation of a man processing an absurd Tuesday morning revelation. Subtle ambient hum of fluorescent lights fills the uncomfortable silence. The shot maintains perfect stillness except for the barely perceptible rise and fall of his shoulders as he breathes, emphasizing the awkward pause before inevitable comedic payoff. Corporate office atmosphere feels suffocatingly mundane, with deep perspective showing rows of empty cubicles stretching into the background.
